mapper.sql: id, business_key, task_type, payload, priority, status, retry_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, fail_reason, version, created_at, updated_at, started_at, finished_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO task (business_key, task_type, payload, priority, status, retry_count, max_attempts, next_retry_at, fail_reason, version, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{businessKey}, #{taskType}, #{payload}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{maxAttempts}, #{nextRetryAt}, #{failReason}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE task SET status = 'RUNNING', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{startedAt}, started_at = CASE WHEN started_at IS NULL THEN #{startedAt} ELSE started_at END WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{expectedVer} AND status = 'WAITING'

UPDATE task SET status = 'SUCCESS', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{finishedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, fail_reason = NULL, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{expectedVer} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE task SET status = 'RETRY_WAITING', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{nextRetryAt}, retry_count = #{retryCount}, next_retry_at = #{nextRetryAt}, fail_reason = #{failReason} WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{expectedVer} AND status = 'RUNNING'

UPDATE task SET status = 'DEAD_LETTER', version = version + 1, updated_at = #{finishedAt}, finished_at = #{finishedAt}, fail_reason = #{failReason}, next_retry_at = NULL WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{expectedVer} AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task WHERE status = #{status}
SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM task GROUP BY status
